newsitem.title: GERMANY: Holzmann denies head departure speculation.
newsitem.headline: Holzmann denies head departure speculation.

text.p: Troubled German construction company Philipp Holzmann AG denied speculation in next Monday's edition of the German business newsletter Platow Brief that its supervisory board chairman Hermann Becker is to resign.
"It is patently untrue that Hermann Becker will give up his post as supervisory board chairman," Christoph Peez told Reuters late on Saturday.
The Platow Brief report is only the latest instalment in a rash of speculation surrounding the construction group.
On Friday Holzmann denied reports in the mass-circulation Bild Zeitung that its chief executive Lothar Mayer faced possible dismissal over losses on a property project.
Earlier in the week the group denied it faced liquidity problems.
The board of Holzmann meets on Thursday for a regular meeting. Becker has been chairman of the supervisory board since 1992, before which he was chairman.
